annotations.title: Send a project to Drint 3D Studio

description: Prepare one of the signed-in person's Drint projects for Drint 3D Studio, where its whole product set is staged and rendered as photo-real scenes that come back to the project's Hộp duyệt. Returns a link: it opens the project in Drint with the hand-on menu up, and the person clicks "Dựng cảnh ở 3D Studio" — the products and their artwork are built in their browser, so this tool cannot send them by itself. Take the id from list_my_projects.

lang.description: The user's language (vi, en, th, zh…). Default en.
